Couple of gripes about the app which is so relied upon by family and friends - a lot by me as well in different periods of life

1. The phone number once on WhatsApp is easily found by A. Spammers and B. Random businesses. As such there is no control mechanism about who messages - there is only Carte Blanche consent. For example, if I only would like to use WhatsApp as a messaging service for close family members - it is not currently possible - basically it is a slippery slope where once you sign on to it, even if you want to keep it just to people who are important to you, this is not currently possible in the app.

2. When reporting a conversation there is only “Block and Report” and second, “report”. No third option which I believe is a requirement - something along the lines of “Don’t receive messages anymore from” - so not quite a hard block, however just a soft “no”. This also goes toward consent questions in the wider scheme of things, something which I am sure Meta/Facebook/WhatsApp are very interested in as a huge and responsible modern organisation. 

For example, if a conversation is going poorly for one individual - or is perceived as threatening by an individual, certain AI should be able to assess the validity of a threat perceived by an individual or minority - example unsolicited messages for women/ minorities, and unsolicited messages from businesses who a customer has not consented to allowing being messaged
